Container.Name: NexusBackup-Repository
Container.Overview: Nexus Backup TLS-authenticated Restic REST endpoint for workstation backups. It exposes only dedicated repository storage and local transport credentials; it has no access to Nexus Control state, source data, restore staging or workstation Restic encryption passwords.
Container.Requires: Set Repository host to the LAN DNS name or IPv4 address that Windows workstations use to reach this Unraid host. Workstation repository traffic uses TLS 1.3 on port 8000 by default. The local nexus-repository-client helper carries the public CA certificate and its SHA-256 directly into the elevated workstation onboarding session; Repository exposes no HTTP bootstrap port.

Config.Name: Repository config
Config.Description: Private TLS key, certificate, bcrypt htpasswd file and local workstation transport credentials. Treat this directory as secret.

Config.Name: Workstation repository storage
Config.Description: Dedicated Restic repository data written directly by Windows workstations over the Nexus Repository TLS endpoint. Keep separate from PCWatch and generic Agent repositories.

Config.Name: Repository host
Config.Description: LAN DNS name or IPv4 address used by workstations, for example tower.local or 192.168.1.20. This value is embedded in the self-signed TLS certificate.

Config.Name: Repository TLS port
Config.Description: TLS Restic REST port exposed on the Unraid host.

Config.Name: Initial workstation user
Config.Description: Creates one initial private REST transport principal if it does not exist. Additional per-workstation users can be created from the container console with nexus-repository-client.
